main_body: Loom frame seen straight on: a brown outer frame with a top beam, a white warp-thread panel, a red and yellow checkered band, a bottom beam, and two legs below
top_band: Orange/tan beam at rows ~10-13, but it is the same material as the matching bottom beam at rows ~23-25, so it reads as a vertical front beam, not a top surface
evidence: The column reads dark outline, orange beam, tan strip, grey, white threads, red/yellow checks, then an orange beam that mirrors the top one, dark outline, and legs. The top and bottom beams are symmetrical vertical faces, with no horizontal surface seen from above. The warp panel is painted flat with no inset shading. The legs and base show no top faces. This matches the guide's red 'front elevation' case.

style.evidence: The dark brown outline is tinted to match the wood, which is good. The beams have only 2-3 flat tones, and the thread panel and checker band are regular repeating fills with no grain or per-pixel variation. The side posts are flat brown areas. Tiles carry fewer colours than the stall and well references, so the piece looks flatter and thinner next to them.
